name: Pari English Core
purpose: Select the base LLM by underlying English competence before runtime, memory, quantization, or product routing are considered.

researchBasis.designFramework: Evidence-Centered Benchmark Design (ACL 2024) + HELM-style multi-dimensional reporting
researchBasis.constructPolicy: Every dimension must be tied to a published linguistic/NLP construct or editing benchmark plus a Pari-specific shadow analogue.
researchBasis.weightBasis: product-prior, not a literature-derived psychometric scale
researchBasis.weightRationale: Lexical context and collocation are intentionally emphasized because Pari's primary interaction is contextual word/phrase replacement. Exact percentages are engineering priorities and must not be presented as empirically discovered constants.
researchBasis.sensitivityPolicy: Always report all seven dimensions and an equal-weight mean beside the product-weighted composite. If model ranking changes materially under equal weighting, treat the winner as weight-sensitive rather than universal.
researchBasis.contaminationBasis: Public benchmark results are separated from fresh shadow cases because benchmark contamination can inflate static benchmark scores; shadow cases test the same constructs with new surface forms.
researchBasis.choiceOrderBasis: Forced-choice options are deterministically permuted because LLM multiple-choice performance is known to be sensitive to answer-option order.
researchBasis.judgeBasis: Generative outputs must not be scored solely by one general-purpose LLM judge; use human references, deterministic metrics, or independently validated specialized evaluators where possible.

composite.name: english_core_100
composite.rule: Always publish all seven subscores, the product-weighted composite, and the equal-weight dimension mean. This score must never replace Pari route-specific product acceptance.

lexical_context.researchConstruct: context-sensitive word meaning and lexical substitution

collocation_naturalness.researchConstruct: lexical collocation retrieval/classification and idiomatic compatibility

grammar_syntax.researchConstruct: linguistic acceptability and targeted grammatical phenomena

paraphrase_semantics.researchConstruct: structural/context-sensitive paraphrase equivalence under high lexical overlap

fluency_register.researchConstruct: holistic English fluency plus formality/register discrimination

generative_expression.researchConstruct: controlled text improvement, revision, paraphrasing, and generative writing
publicAnchors: WritingBench selected style/language subsets as secondary evidence

discourse.researchConstruct: discourse relation, temporal relation, coherence, and sentence ordering

evaluationProtocol.publicAnchorPolicy: Use official frozen evaluation splits only. Never fine-tune on evaluation data.
evaluationProtocol.shadowPolicy: Fresh Pari-authored cases are evaluation-only, rotated periodically, and must never be used for training or prompt optimization.
evaluationProtocol.forcedChoice: Prefer direct A/B or label responses. Do not request explanations or chain-of-thought. Deterministically permute option order per case and record the permutation policy.
evaluationProtocol.probabilityScoring: When local runtimes expose token/logit probabilities reliably, record calibrated preference margins in addition to text-answer accuracy; do not silently substitute first-token scoring for observed text answers.
evaluationProtocol.generation: Use fixed task prompts and decoding settings per model class; preserve raw outputs.
evaluationProtocol.judgePolicy: Do not let one generative LLM judge define English Core. Prefer gold labels, human references, deterministic checks, and specialized classifiers; use LLM judges only as secondary diagnostics.
evaluationProtocol.contamination: Report public-anchor and fresh-shadow results separately. A model with strong public scores but weak shadow scores is flagged for possible contamination/benchmark overfitting.
evaluationProtocol.runtimeSeparation: Latency, RAM, quantization and MTP are reported after English Core. They do not change the English competence score.
evaluationProtocol.sampling: Fast public subsets are engineering screens. Official/full benchmark metrics remain authoritative for research reporting.
evaluationProtocol.weightSensitivity: Report both product-weighted and equal-weight composites and inspect per-dimension rankings before selecting a winner.

promotion.englishCoreUse: Rank base LLM candidates by English Core profile and composites.
promotion.productUse: After English Core selection, run the existing Pari route-specific V1 acceptance suite.
promotion.hardRule: A high English Core score does not override semantic/safety veto failures in the product benchmark.
